page.notes: Woodcut decorative initial "Q" beside the question list: an ornament, not transcribed as text. Greek word at the end of item 4 of the first paragraph is doubtful; the last letters are uncertain, so I marked the word [?]. The "Luc. 21. 17." note is placed beside the line of "mutauit". Fragments at the far right edge belong to the neighbouring page and were left out. The catchword "tita" is the start of the next page's word "repetita". Page number read as 578.
